description: Runoff for Russia version 1.0 publishes simulated runoff, meteorological forcing and hydrological-state series for 425 river basins across Russia. The State Hydrological Institute deposit covers historical forcing from 1979 to 2016 and projected conditions from 2017 to 2099. The describing article says the HBV hydrological model was driven by ISIMIP weather inputs and four general-circulation models under three emissions pathways. The Zenodo page lists a public compressed archive and CC BY 4.0. A modeller could use the runoff trajectories to stress-test flood exposure at river crossings, reservoirs or other water infrastructure, or compare adaptation scenarios across basins. These are model outputs, not gauge observations. Bias correction, HBV structure and future emissions assumptions constrain interpretation, particularly at an individual asset. The archive contents and basin identifiers were not downloaded or checked. No directly related catalogue dataset was identified.
name: Runoff for Russia (RFR v1.0)
